title: AgentHeal: Evaluating Goal-Preserving Resource Recovery of Web Agents under Access Barriers
topic: 访问障碍与目标保真恢复
first_author_affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China
code_status: 论文链接的作者官方代码与数据仓库公开；已核对agentheal、dataset、dataset_real、scripts与tests目录，未执行上游全部模型评测
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.agent_research.agentheal import diagnostic; print(diagnostic())'

cost_assessment.available_resource: one NVIDIA A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.model_scale: 13 models,including8B/9B/27B local checkpoints and paid API models,plus semantic LLM judge
cost_assessment.data_scale: 855 tasks,up to60 steps per episode,real web replay and independent audit
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: full actor/model/task/judge matrix is long-running and resource cost is not bounded by the lightweight evaluator;published configuration,not a measured local runtime
cost_assessment.decision: 完整实验成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；只执行独立评价侧状态合同，不调浏览器、模型或judge，不自动重试

summary: 用同一用户目标的可达原版副本、其他版本与假相似资源区分恢复行为；精确副本优先、退到其他版本须披露差异、真正不可恢复时诚实弃答并诊断障碍，所有情形都要求遵守访问政策。
fidelity_note: 仅CPU离线评测核，执行Eq1–3的来源/版本/合规与不可恢复弃答判定、失败保留和分组分母；元数据、来源归因和逐动作政策判断均由独立外层提供，不自动理解网页、答案或政策。没有web actor、真实浏览器、LLM judge、RR/AA完整语义评测或Evolve晋级。855任务、13模型、每题至多60步及judge的完整实验成本过高，不复现（审查DONE）。
